tools.name: list_human_services
tools.description: List Ron Long’s human infrastructure services within 100 miles of Irvine, Orange County, CA and intake requirements. Custom quotes; payments disabled. No system access granted.

tools.name: request_human_task
tools.description: Submit a real task request to Ron Long using previously delegated authority. Job location must be within 100 miles of Irvine, Orange County, CA. Creates a review request, not a booking or charge. Never include credentials. Save the returned private task token.

tools.name: get_human_task_status
tools.description: Read the status of your own task using its ID and private task token. Never reveals other requests.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_human_task" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
